sections.heading: Summary

paragraphs: Per the file, v1 txs have a 4096-byte size (per the file) limit and encode each acct address directly as 32 bytes, (per the file) without address lookup tables. Per the file, by comparison, 128 acct addresses alone would consume the entire tx size limit. Per the file, the 96-acct limit balances access to more accts with room for the rest of the tx.
